name: vault-skills
description: Six vault-* workflow skills (vault-capture, vault-save, vault-journal, vault-synthesize, vault-moc, vault-health) vendored from az9713/claude-code-obsidian. Companion to obsidian-skills (kepano's foundational five) — those handle the file formats; these run the daily vault workflows: quick-capture into the inbox, structured saves into the right folder, daily-journal authoring, multi-note synthesis, Map-of-Content authoring, and vault-health audits (orphan notes, broken links, stale tags).
